query:
UPDATE cheers_sessions
         SET provider_session_id = COALESCE($1, provider_session_id),
             metadata = CASE
                WHEN $2::text IS NULL THEN metadata
                WHEN jsonb_typeof($2::jsonb) = 'object' THEN COALESCE(metadata, '{}'::jsonb) || $2::jsonb
                ELSE metadata
             END,
             status = $3,
             last_used_at = $4,
             updated_at = $4
         WHERE session_id = $5
         RETURNING session_id
